title: Replay tests for the workflows; search attributes on PR workflows
body:
Closes #32

## Why
`workflow.patched()` guards were untested: a workflow edit that breaks replay would only show up as stuck in-flight workflows. PR workflows were also only findable by type.

## What
- `tests/histories/*.json`: recorded histories for SessionWorkflow (digest flush, approval nudge/expiry, reply), GithubPollWorkflow, PrReviewWorkflow (+ helper child), MergePrWorkflow (wait→merge, update-branch, conflict-resolve), plus two recorded with the pre-#28 code (`legacy_*`), so the `patched()` paths are proven against old histories.
- `tests/test_replay.py` replays them with `temporalio.worker.Replayer` (no server) and has a harness check that a changed workflow fails. I also verified by hand that removing the `digest-flush` guard fails the two session histories.
- `tests/histories/capture.py` / `capture_legacy.py` regenerate them (scripted model, stubbed GitHub activities, local Temporal).
- `aoa/search_attrs.py`: `Repo`, `PrNumber`, `Sha`, `Session`, registered idempotently at worker and server start; set on `MergePrWorkflow` (server; falls back to no attributes if the server does not know them) and on the `PrReviewWorkflow` child (guarded by `workflow.patched("pr-search-attrs")`).
- Approval notices format short durations correctly (the reviewer noted "0h" on #31).
- CLAUDE.md gets the replay-compatibility rule; session log.

## Testing
191 passed, including an e2e that starts a workflow with the attributes and finds it with `Repo = ... AND PrNumber = ... AND Sha = ...`.
